subject: Queen Gohma
text: Hitting Queen Gohma's eye with the Fairy Slingshot stuns her, allowing Link to slash her eye repeatedly.

evidence.quote: Hit the eye with the Fairy Slingshot to stun her, then get up to her eye and slash at the eye repeatedly.

subject: Queen Gohma
text: When Queen Gohma crawls to the ceiling and drops eggs, Link should break the eggs before the Larvae hatch.

evidence.quote: Once she's at the ceiling, she'll drop eggs that contain her offspring. Break the eggs before the Larvae hatch so that you won't have any trouble.

subject: Queen Gohma
text: Queen Gohma can be quickly defeated in one sequence by stunning her with the Fairy Slingshot, jump slashing with a Deku Stick, and repeatedly pressing B while holding R without locking on.

evidence.quote: Stun her with the Fairy Slingshot, then jump slash with a Deku Stick to do a lot of damage. Afterwards, hold R while facing her (without locking on) and press B repeatedly to stab her to death. This method should only require one sequence.

subject: Queen Gohma
text: If Queen Gohma reaches the ceiling to lay eggs, shooting her red eye with the Fairy Slingshot knocks her back to the ground.

evidence.quote: If by chance you don't kill her in time, when she's at the ceiling laying eggs, shoot her in the eye while it's red with the Fairy Slingshot, and she'll fall to the ground, open for another attack.

subject: Queen Gohma
text: Defeating Queen Gohma rewards a Heart Container and creates a warp light.

evidence.quote: Either way, after she's dead, a light and HEART CONTAINER will appear. Make sure you pick up the Container before leaving by stepping into the light.

subject: Great Deku Tree
text: After defeating Queen Gohma, the Great Deku Tree gives Link the Kokiri Emerald before dying.

evidence.quote: He'll talk to you a bit more, give you the Kokiri Emerald, and then die. (Due to the curse.) Head out, and Mido will blame you for the Deku Tree's death.

subject: Saria
text: Saria stops Link as he exits Kokiri Forest to the west and gives him the Fairy Ocarina.

evidence.quote: Check on a few things, and then leave the Kokiri Forest by heading west. While leaving, Saria will stop you and talk to you. After giving you the FAIRY OCARINA, she'll let you leave.

subject: Know-it-All Brothers' House
text: A Gold Skulltula is found behind the Know-it-All Brothers' House at nighttime.

evidence.quote: Now before heading forward, wait until it's nighttime, then head back into Kokiri Forest. Look behind the Know-it-All Brothers' House for a Gold Skulltula.

subject: Lost Woods Target
text: Hitting the center of the target three times with the Fairy Slingshot makes a Deku Scrub award the Big Bullet Bag, expanding Deku Seed capacity to 40.

evidence.quote: Whip out your Fairy Slingshot and try to hit the center of the target three times. If you do, a Deku Scrub will pop out and give you a BIG BULLET BAG, which allows you to carry 40 Deku Seeds, as opposed to 30 for your Slingshot.

subject: Skull Kids
text: Playing along with the songs of the two Skull Kids three times on the Fairy Ocarina rewards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Get on the lone stump and pull out your Fairy Ocarina while facing them. They'll ask you to follow along with their songs. If you do it successfully three times, (you may need a piece of paper to write down their songs) they'll give you a Piece of Heart

subject: Business Deku Scrub
text: Under the bridge leading to Hyrule Field, a Business Deku Scrub sells a Deku Stick upgrade to carry 20 sticks for 40 Rupees after you deflect a nut back at him.

evidence.quote: Head under the bridge and you will find a Business Deku Scrub. Deflect a Nut back at him and he'll give you a DEKU STICK UPGRADE, allowing you to carry 20 now. (Note: You must have 40 Rupees before you can get this.)

subject: Guard House Crate
text: Rolling into the crate next to the guard inside the town gate guard house breaks it and reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: As soon as you enter the Town gates, head into the guard's house... You see the guard standing there? Roll (press A while running) into the crate next to him to break it and reveal the Skulltula.

subject: Shooting Gallery
text: Hitting all the Rupees in the Shooting Gallery with the Fairy Slingshot for 20 Rupees awards the Biggest Bullet Bag, increasing seed capacity to 50, and hitting at least 8 targets earns a free game.

evidence.quote: In here, you must hit all the Rupees that appear with your Slingshot. If successful, you'll get the BIGGEST BULLET BAG; an item that lets you carry 50 Deku Seeds... Each game costs 20 Rupees, so try your best and make sure you have a lot of Rupees. (Note: If you hit at least 8 targets, you'll get a free game. Make sure you do that!)

subject: Castle Grounds Tree
text: Rolling into the lone tree in the Castle Grounds knocks down a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: While waiting, roll into the lone tree you see to knock down another Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 006 out of 100)

subject: Richard's Owner
text: Returning the white dog found near the house with the man looking out the window to the woman in the Back Alley at night rewards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Head into the Back Alley (via heading left once reaching the Shooting Gallery) and continue walking through until you see a rather obese woman complaining that her dog is loose... Head back into the main Market, and look for the white dog near the house with the guy looking out his window. The dog will automatically follow you. Bring the dog back to the woman's house and she'll give you a Piece of Heart.

subject: Malon
text: Talking to Malon in the Castle Grounds gives Link an Egg to find her dad.

evidence.quote: You should see the red-haired girl (Malon) here now, singing a song. Talk to her, and she'll give you an EGG, as long as you find her dad.

subject: Talon
text: Using the Cucco that hatches from Malon's egg during daytime wakes Talon up in the Castle Grounds.

evidence.quote: It should be daytime by now, and the egg should've hatched. Use the CUCCO that hatched from it to wake up Talon, then talk to him. He'll run back to Malon all in a worry.

subject: Courtyard Window
text: Firing a Deku Seed into the right window before speaking to Princess Zelda rewards a Red Rupee worth 20 normal Rupees.

evidence.quote: Before talking to her, fire a Deku Seed into the right window for a Red Rupee – worth 20 normal Rupees.

subject: Princess Zelda
text: Princess Zelda explains her dream and gives Link a Letter with her signature.

evidence.quote: Talk to Princess Zelda and she'll tell you a story about her dream. After the lengthy explanation, (make sure to pick the top option whenever given it) she'll tell you to get the two other Spiritual Stones (Kokiri Emerald is one of them), and also give you a LETTER with her signature.

subject: Impa
text: Impa escorts Link out of Hyrule Market and teaches him Zelda's Lullaby.

evidence.quote: Head out and Impa, Zelda's bodyguard will escort you out of Hyrule Market nicely, after teaching you ZELDA'S LULLABY, which is very important in the game.

subject: Super Cucco Minigame
text: Finding three Super Cuccos within the time limit in Talon's minigame for 10 Rupees rewards a Bottle filled with Lon Lon Milk.

evidence.quote: Inside is Talon, with a bunch of Cuccos. Talk to him and he'll ask you to play a game at the cost of 10 Rupees. You have to find three Super Cuccos (they look the same as ordinary ones) within a limited time... If you do get all three, Talon will reward you with a BOTTLE of Lon Lon Milk.

subject: Lon Lon Ranch Tree
text: Rolling into the lone tree left of Talon's house knocks down a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: At the left of the house that had Talon inside is a lone tree with a couple crates beside it. Roll into the tree to knock another Gold Skulltula off.

subject: Lon Lon Ranch Silo
text: Moving crates at the back of the silo reveals a corner crawlspace leading to a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Head into the silo at the back. You'll see two cows and a bunch of crates at the far end. Move the crates in such a way so that the crawlspace in the corner is revealed. Head through the crawlspace to find a Piece of Heart.

subject: Malon
text: Talking to Malon three times inside the corral and equipping the Fairy Ocarina in front of her teaches Link Epona's Song, which causes cows to fill an empty bottle with Lon Lon Milk.

evidence.quote: Head out of the silo and head inside the corral and talk to Malon three times. (She should say something about singing a song together on the third time.) After that, equip the Fairy Ocarina in front of her. She'll teach you EPONA'S SONG for your trouble. Now that you have this song, whenever you're near a cow, playing this song will please the cow and fill one of your Empty Bottles with Lon Lon Milk for free.

subject: Lon Lon Ranch Feeding Pen
text: A Gold Skulltula appears on the back of the horse corral feeding pen at night.

evidence.quote: Exit the ranch, then enter again once night arrives. Head to the back of the horse corral and you'll see a Gold Skulltula on the back of the feeding pen. Kill it.

subject: Kokiri Shop Dirt Plot
text: Dropping a bottle of bugs onto the soft dirt plot east of the Kokiri Shop causes a Gold Skulltula to appear.

evidence.quote: Once back in the forest, head to the dirt plot to the east of the Kokiri Shop. Drop your Bottle of Bugs on the patch of dirt and they'll burrow right into the little hole in the center... A Gold Skulltula should pop out. Kill it and collect its token.

subject: Lost Woods Dirt Plot
text: Dropping bugs onto the soft dirt plot reached by going left and left from the Lost Woods entrance reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Head left from the entrance, then head left again to reach another plot of dirt. Drop some more bugs from your bottle (you should've caught another one at the first plot of dirt) and yet another Gold Skulltula will pop out.

subject: Meadow Gate Dirt Plot
text: Dropping bugs onto the patch of dirt behind a Deku Scrub in the grassy area reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Head into the right entrance, then left, then left again. You'll be at a grassy area. Behind one of the Deku Scrubs is yet another patch of dirt. Drop the bugs here to make a Gold Skulltula pop out.

subject: Deku Brothers Door
text: Hitting the three Deku brothers in the correct sequence opens the door leading to Queen Gohma.

evidence.quote: Harm them in the correct sequence and they'll open the door to Queen Gohma.

subject: Moat Blocks
text: Pushing the two bull head blocks into the moat indentation allows Link to climb up and jump to the alcove entrance.

evidence.quote: Near where Talon was are two blocks with bull heads on them. Push these blocks over to the moat where the indentation leads to. The second block fits over the first one. Once you have them at the correct spot, you should hear a jingle. Climb up the blocks and jump across to the alcove.
